customers.evidence: Focus on the user and all else will follow.

employees.evidence: We believe that great, creative things are more likely to happen with the right company culture

dei.evidence: energetic, passionate people from diverse backgrounds with creative approaches to work

community.evidence: our mission is to facilitate access to information for the entire world, and in every language

shareholders.evidence: You can make money without doing evil.

integrity.evidence: We never manipulate rankings to put our partners higher in our search results and no one can buy better PageRank.

innovation.evidence: Through innovation and iteration, we aim to take things that work well and improve upon them in unexpected ways.

result.analyst_notes: Written in first-person plural with aspirational, user-first framing; the page opens with a headline principle and then elaborates. Commitments are often absolute (never, always, firmly believe), though some are hedged (we hope, we aim, we try). Users lead, followed by integrity, innovation and culture. Shareholder and environmental themes are largely absent, and the tone is conversational and self-referential.
